items.title: Finite point sets in a separated locally quasi-finite scheme over an affine lie in a common affine open
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y separated locally quasi-finite with Y affine, every finite set of points of X is contained in an open affine of X — the affineness-of-finite-sets gadget used in quasi-finite structure arguments. The retained proof is written: enclose the points in a quasi-compact open U; U -> Y is quasi-affine by the Zariski-Main-Theorem form lemma quasi-finite-separated-quasi-affine (already collected); Hence there exists an affine open V ⊂ U containing the chosen points by the quasi-affine ampleness dictionary (Properties, lemma ample-finite-set-in-affine). Retained author proof at lines 12668-12675.
